fitzgen opened issue #15234:

Follow up to https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/pull/15224

We can now record which functions never throw and translate calls to them into regular CLIF calls rather than CLIF try_calls, which avoids the spill-everything ABI and produces better code under register pressure. That initial PR only marked certain FACT intrinsics as never-throw, but we should be able to mark a bunch more, such as most (all?) of our libcalls.
fitzgen added the cranelift:goal:optimize-speed label to Issue #15234.

friendlymatthew commented on issue #15234:

Hi, I opened a small PR covering lowered component imports. I'm tackling this case separately as I get familiar with the codebase, curious to get your thoughts !
